category: Setting up a ledger in a project

history.name: The product's name, line and audience
history.description: A ledger knows what product it describes, what that product is in one line, and who it is prepared for. Those three settings are what the generated documents introduce themselves with — the titles, the opening paragraphs and the closing note are all built from them — so a freshly created ledger reads as though it were written for this product rather than filled in from a template. The name defaults to the project's own folder if none is given.
history.dev_notes: config.json's product / tagline / prepared_for, set by `ledger init --product --tagline --prepared-for`; consumed by src/wording.mjs, which folds the tagline into the intro sentences.
